<div class="chatbot-container">

<div class="chat-header">
<h1>Ask About Isfar</h1>
<h3>Get insights about her background, experience, and expertise</h3>
<div class="chatbot-disclaimer">
<small>This AI assistant provides information about Isfar's professional background and achievements. For direct conversations or specific opportunities, please <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/isfarbaset/" target="_blank">connect on LinkedIn</a> or reach out directly.</small>
</div>
</div>

<div class="chat-window">
<div class="chat-messages">
<div class="message bot-message">
<div class="message-content">
Hi there! I'm an AI assistant here to share insights about Isfar Baset's journey and work. You can ask me about:

• Her path so far in building a career in data science <br>
• Technical toolkit: Python, SQL, machine learning, NLP, cloud computing <br>
• Education: MS in Data Science (Georgetown), BS in Computer Science <br>
• Work Experience and Projects <br>

Think of me as your guide if you're curious about her background, skills, or projects. Where would you like to start?
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="chat-input-container">
<div class="suggested-questions">
<div class="suggestion-chip">Tell me about her background</div>
<div class="suggestion-chip">What's her experience?</div>
<div class="suggestion-chip">What are her skills?</div>
<div class="suggestion-chip">What are her hobbies?</div>
</div>

<div class="chat-input-wrapper">
<textarea id="chat-input" placeholder="Type your question here..." rows="1"></textarea>
<button id="send-button">
<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
<path d="m22 2-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/>
<path d="m22 2-11 10"/>
</svg>
</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<script src="chatbot.js"></script>

<script>
// Initialize the chatbot when page loads
console.log('🎯 Initializing chatbot with external JS...');

const chatbotAI = new IsfarChatbotAI();

// Message handling functions
function addMessage(content, isBot = false, withTyping = false) {
  console.log('📝 Adding message:', content);
  const messagesContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-messages');
  const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
  messageDiv.className = `message ${isBot ? 'bot-message' : 'user-message'}`;
  
  const messageContent = document.createElement('div');
  messageContent.className = 'message-content';
  messageContent.textContent = content;
  messageDiv.appendChild(messageContent);
  messagesContainer.appendChild(messageDiv);
  messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
  
  return messageDiv;
}

function addTypingIndicator() {
  const messagesContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-messages');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'message bot-message typing-indicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="message-content"><div class="typing-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div></div>';
  messagesContainer.appendChild(typingDiv);
  messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
  return typingDiv;
}

function removeTypingIndicator(typingDiv) {
  if (typingDiv && typingDiv.parentNode) {
    typingDiv.parentNode.removeChild(typingDiv);
  }
}

// Main message handling
function handleUserMessage(message) {
  console.log('💬 Handling user message:', message);
  if (!message.trim()) return;
  
  if (chatbotAI.isProcessing) return;
  
  chatbotAI.isProcessing = true;
  
  // Add user message
  addMessage(message, false);
  
  // Show thinking indicator
  const typingIndicator = addTypingIndicator();
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      removeTypingIndicator(typingIndicator);
      const response = chatbotAI.generateResponse(message);
      addMessage(response, true);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('❌ Response error:', error);
      removeTypingIndicator(typingIndicator);
      addMessage("I apologize, but I encountered an issue. Please try again!", true);
    } finally {
      chatbotAI.isProcessing = false;
    }
  }, 1500);
}

// Event listeners
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  console.log('🎯 DOM loaded - setting up event listeners');
  
  const chatInput = document.getElementById('chat-input');
  const sendButton = document.getElementById('send-button');
  const suggestionChips = document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-chip');
  
  if (!chatInput || !sendButton) {
    console.error('❌ Critical elements not found!');
    return;
  }
  
  function sendMessage() {
    const message = chatInput.value.trim();
    if (message && !chatbotAI.isProcessing) {
      handleUserMessage(message);
      chatInput.value = '';
    }
  }
  
  sendButton.addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
  
  chatInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      sendMessage();
    }
  });
  
  chatInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
    const value = this.value.trim();
    sendButton.disabled = !value || chatbotAI.isProcessing;
    
    // Auto-resize textarea
    this.style.height = 'auto';
    this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 120) + 'px';
    
    if (this.scrollHeight < 56) {
      this.style.height = '56px';
    }
  });
  
  suggestionChips.forEach(chip => {
    chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const question = this.textContent;
      if (!chatbotAI.isProcessing) {
        chatInput.value = question;
        setTimeout(() => sendMessage(), 100);
      }
    });
  });
  
  console.log('✅ Chatbot initialized successfully with external JavaScript!');
});
</script>

<style>

  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 3rem 1rem;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: #fafafa;
  border-radius: 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
  padding: 3rem 2rem 2rem 2rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #007AFF 0%, #5856D6 100%);
  color: white;
  border-radius: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.25), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
}

  margin: 0 0 0.75rem 0;

}

  margin: 0;

  opacity: 0.85;
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: 12px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

  display: block;

  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 400;
}

  color: white;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 500;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}

.chatbot-disclaimer a:hover {
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.chat-window {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 600px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.chat-messages {
  flex: 1;

}

  to {

.typing-dots span:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: -0.32s; }

@keyframes typingDot {

    transform: scale(0);

}

}

}

</style>
